title: amomum neoaurantiacum
intro: Amomum neoaurantiacum, commonly known as the lesser cardamom or Chinese cardamom, is a type of rhizomatous perennial plant belonging to the ginger family (Zingiberaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to relieve digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and improve respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Amomum neoaurantiacum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gingerols, shogaols, and other bioactive compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
